senses.gloss: m. (βαλανεύς) bathing master, bathing attendant (who receives a small coin as fee, cmp. אוֹלְיָיר).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 4:6:2">Y. B. Bath. IV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מקום הב׳</he> the bathing master’s station (the income therefrom); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כַּלָּנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 4:2">Sabb. IV, 2</cite> <he>קורות הב׳</he> the beams whereon the bathing masters are stationed.
